findings.claim: FY2025 10-K Item 3 稱未決法律事項預期不致對營運、財務、流動性或現金流造成重大不利影響；最重大訴訟為 Aldrich 與 Murray 石棉破產案，未列政府反壟斷調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: The most significant litigation facing the Company is the asbestos-related bankruptcy cases of Aldrich and Murray.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因素列示公司受反托拉斯等多項法規規範，違規可能面臨罰款、禁制令等；為通用風險揭露，非具體調查。
findings.excerpt: We are subject to regulation under a wide variety of U.S. federal and state and non-U.S. laws, regulations and policies, including laws related to anti-corruption, anti-human trafficking, anti-bribery including the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act and the U.K. Bribery Act, export and import compliance, anti-trust, cybersecurity, data privacy, and money laundering
